notes.title: UPDATE !!
notes.notes:
First of all we would like to apologize for the long delay in releasing an update.

We have just released an update for JUST BAT with the most requested changes:

1. No more annoying background music
2. Improved bat-ball collision physics (The ball no longer goes through the bat and it is much more difficult to hit 4s and 6s)
3. The helmet no longer comes off accidentally when playing shots
4. The user is given full freedom to choose between fast, off spin and leg spin during free play mode
5. The user can now change the ball speed and landing position while the game is paused
6. The leader board issue will be fixed soon
7. Keep an eye for more updates soon

Also check out our brand new VR simulation: Space Badminton VR
http://store.steampowered.com/app/575560

Thank You
Life VR Team
